messages:
alex: Quick flag — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5112 needs 2x LGTM before the 16:00 UTC cutoff for today's hotfix deploy. It's blocking the rollback for the 4.2.1 incident. Can folks take a look?

kevin: On it, assigning myself to review. Any specific parts to watch for? perf regressions or config changes?

alex: Mostly runtime routing fallback logic and a small config change in autoscale. See comment by @jess about fallback order — tests added. CI is green locally but want an extra eyes on rollout policy.

jess: I'll review now. Focus on the canary fallback ordering — I left inline comments in the PR. If that looks good I'll LGTM.

ci-bot: CI: All checks passed on commit abc123 — unit 312/312, integration 45/45, e2e flaky: 1 skipped. Build URL: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/3821

sara: I can do the second LGTM after jess. If jess approves before 15:40 UTC I can merge and trigger the release pipeline.

kevin: Left a small suggestion re: variable naming. Not a blocker but makes future diffs easier. Will approve after that's addressed.

jess: Updated per kevin's note and addressed my own comment. Re-running tests, but nothing major. LGTM :thumbsup:

kevin: LGTM — approving now.

alex: Thanks all — @sara can you merge when CI finishes? Aim to cut by 15:55 UTC to account for rollback window.

sara: Merging now. /merge https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5112

deploy-bot: Deploy started: hotfix/4.2.1 -> staging -> prod. Expected window 10m. Trace: deploy/7890

alex: Monitoring. If we see >200ms p95 on routing, we will rollback. I'll keep the channel posted.

oncall: Oncall monitoring alert: small spike at 4m into deploy, p95 increased to 220ms, watching dashboards.

alex: Rolling back based on spike — rollback initiated.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed — service returned to previous revision. Incident link: https://incident.redwood.ai/INC-2026

sara: Thanks for the quick reviews. We'll reopen PR to iterate. Next time let's try to verify canary traffic more thoroughly before full promote.
